name: Roasted Pork Tenderloin with Mustard Potatoes

components.name: Pork Tenderloin & Mustard Sauce
steps: Season raw pork tenderloin and briefly sear in 20 ml oil in an oven-safe pan until browned on each side.
Move the pan with pork into the oven. Roast until the thickest part reaches 63 C (145 F), followed by a rest of at least three minutes, or to a higher household preference.
Remove the pork to rest. In its pan combine stock, Dijon, cream, butter and tarragon; reduce gently to a spoon-coating sauce.
Slice tenderloin and divide with potatoes, beans and measured sauce across five meals. Refrigerate promptly.

components.name: Roasted Potatoes & Green Beans
steps: Heat oven to 210 C. Toss halved potatoes with their oil, salt and thyme and place cut side down on a roasting tray.
Roast potatoes around 30-40 minutes until golden; add green beans tossed with oil to a separate tray for the final 12-15 minutes.
